meta.notes: Orange Gate DBR Rev 0 baseline design. Hydraulic target: K 4.1 at 50 bar gives 29.0 lpm per head; 25 heads per 30 m zone; 3 simultaneous zones yield 2175 lpm. This file is the golden-deck baseline for the optimisation loop.
